title: Basketball Data Repository
short_summary: Curated basketball datasets with exploratory analysis for analytics and BI use cases
summary: Dataset-focused analytics project providing structured basketball data for historical analysis, dashboarding, and modeling. The repository emphasizes clean, reusable datasets with supporting exploratory analysis and examples suitable for SQL, Python, and BI tools.

components.name: Raw Basketball Datasets
components.objective: Provide raw basketball data suitable for cleaning and downstream analytics
components.business_value: Establishes a reproducible source of basketball data for analysis and BI projects

components.name: Cleaned Analytical Datasets
components.objective: Clean, normalize, and structure basketball datasets for analysis
components.business_value: Improves usability and reliability of data for analytics and modeling

components.name: Exploratory Data Analysis
components.objective: Explore basketball trends and patterns through analysis and visualization
components.business_value: Demonstrates analytical thinking and domain understanding using real sports data
